workflow.title: Review stale developer artifacts before clearing Mac storage
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide whether an old project artifact is rebuildable, actively used, orphaned, or original data before acting on a cleaner result.
workflow.leadConclusion: Review project ownership and rebuild cost before selecting artifacts. Purge documents stale-project and orphaned-worktree rules; those are not permission to discard uncommitted work.
sections: Separate global tool caches from project output and original files
Use Purge’s documented stale-project and worktree boundaries without treating age as consent
Check rebuild access, offline requirements and unsaved work
Distinguish Trash moves from permanent simulator/snapshot operations and actual free-space change
Investigate repeat growth before choosing the next cleanup
workflow.interactionPass: Plan a non-mutating checklist: known owner? active terminal/agent? original or reproducible? dependencies available? uncommitted work? Trash or permanent? No filesystem scanning, cleanup buttons, guaranteed savings or forced demo repo.
visualPlan: Official Purge Overview after lead; caption vendor illustration
Breathing Room Space later at the investigate-growth decision; retain example-data labels
workflow.boundaries: No copied shell deletion commands or performed-cleanup narrative. Explain build/download costs and preserve backups; add no numeric savings.
